print_errors.note: Printed with fatha on dal (and no fatha on nun) in item (١٣); expected سَيِّدِنَا. Kept as printed (same as day-4 counterpart p.134).
Dal carries both damma and kasra in print; kept both.
Damma on أحمد where genitive expected; kept as printed.
Red divine Name printed without fatha on waw, unlike other names; kept as printed.
Print shows a space before the final period; written without space per §2.
